buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 3. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Technical Specifications and Terms and Conditions 1. ITEM DESCRIPTION :CEMENT TYPE :POZZOLANA PORTLAND CEMENT (PPC) STANDARD :IS 1489 PART-I QUANTITY:50 KG/BAG" 2. Weighment tolerance at +/- 0.5% of each lot/consignment and quantity variation +/- 5 % of ordered quantity. 3. Supply, transportation by rail/road up to NTPC Dadri store/site, unloading and stacking is in the scope of supplie r. Safety norms applicable at the plant to be followed strictly while stacking and unloading. 4. Damage/torn bag or frozen/set cement will not be accepted.

5. Cement shall be supplied in HDPE bags of capacity 50 kg each, conforming toI S 11652: 1986, bearing manufact ure's name, week of manufacturing, and grade of cement. 6. Date of receipt of cement at site shall not be more than 2 weeks old from the date of manufacture. 7. Documents to be submitted: a. Manufacturers Test Certificate against each week of manufacture as mentioned in the bag of cement. b. Delivery Challan/Invoice mentioning week of manufacture of cement. 8. The Manufacturers Test Certificate should indicate fineness, normal consistency, initial & final setting time, sound ness, compressive strength, and any other test result as per tender specification. 9. Sampling & Testing: A) After receiving of cement at NTPC Dadri Store/site, cement shall be tested at NTPC Dadri Lab for Fineness, setting time & Compressive strength as per IS 1489 PART-I. B) In case of cement fails to achieve the desired minimum 28 days compressive strength as peIrS 148 9 PART-I at NTPC Dadri Lab, sampling of cement shall be made in presence of representatives from C&M/store department, FQA department and supplier for the supplied quantity of each week number. Afterwards, the sampled cement specimen shall be tested at NTPC Approved Third Party Lab for Fi neness, setting time & Compressive strength as per IS 1489 PART-I. The cost of the above testing in cluding transportation charges shall be borne by the supplier. In case Cement fails to achieve the desired minimum 28 days compressive strength as per IS 1489 PART-I, Supplier has to replace the total lot without any extra financial implication to NT PC. Lot means the total supplied quantity in particular week as printed on the bag of cement. 10. Payment Terms: The Consignee Receipt & Acceptance Certificate (CRAC) on GeM portal shall be generated for sup plied cement only after meeting the quality requirement/acceptance criteria of that batch/lot of cement. The paym ent shall be done as per payment terms of GEM GTC i.e.,100% payment will be released within ten (10) days of issu e of consignee receipt cum-acceptance certificate (CRAC) and on-line submission of bills. 11. Delivery Period: Supply to be done in 12 months in a staggered manner as per requirement oNf TPC Dadri only. Cement to be supplied within 10 days of intimation. 12. Vehicle deployed for transportation of cement shall have valid documents like valid national permits, Driver licens e, valid fitness certificate, PUC certificate etc as per rules.

For Limited Tender Enlistment: NTPC has enlisted certain vendors for the tendered items for Material Enlist ment Group 03MEG-02, Name:" Vendor Enlistment for "Supply of PPC Cement as per IS: 1489:2015 Part-1” Offers from the bidders who have been enlisted by NTPC as said above shall only be considered subject to meeting AATO (Average Annual Turnover) and EC (Execution Capability) equal to or more than Rs. 1,11,10 ,173/-. Offers from vendors not meeting the above criteria shall not be evaluated and shall be rejected. The enlistment of the bidder should be valid as on the date of issuance of NIT. All other terms conditions are as per attached ATC documents . Vendor must read attached ATC docu ments at the time of submission of offer. . 5.
